_help: Levelling and monster scaling. xp: experience needed to go from level L to L+1 = base + lin*(L-1) + quad*(L-1)^2 + cube*(L-1)^3 (easy early, steep later). levelUp: points granted per level (attr = attribute points, rank = skill points for the Skills menu, tree = skill tree points). dungeon: monster level = your level + levelOffset + perDepth*(depth-1); bossBonus is added for the boss. gear: the best tier whose depth <= the current depth is worn by every dungeon monster (hpP/dmgP in %, armor/mr flat, lootBonus raises item rarity). upgrades: rolled per monster; count = base + perDepth*(depth-1) (capped at max), bosses get bossExtra more. Upgrade fields: hpP, dmgP, spdP, cdP (attack cooldown %), windP (wind-up %), armor, mr, res {type: %}, onHit {status: chance 0-1}, dmgType, reach (%), xpP and lootBonus.

scaling._help: Monster health and damage by level: base x (1 + lin*(L-1)) x exp^(L-1), a smooth curve that keeps bending upward so monsters out-grow a hero's gear. power: a floor tied to the hero being fought, so gear never makes monsters trivial: health is at least hpHits x the hero's weapon hit x (monster base hp / refHp)^shape, and every blow deals at least hitPct of the hero's max health x (base dmg / refDmg)^shape before armor (armor still counts, to the power defenseRespect: 1 = fully, 0 = not at all). armor: the hero's physical (and, with half armor + magic resist, elemental) damage taken = K / (K + armor), K = k + perLevel x attacker level, so armor has to keep up with the monsters' level instead of stacking to immunity.

overworld._help: Overworld monsters follow the hero: level = max(the area's level, hero level + offset + (area level - 1) x areaWeight). Bosses add bossBonus. In multiplayer the hero level is the average of everyone in the world.

party._help: Multiplayer parties. xpPool: a party kill pays this share of the normal experience, split evenly between the party members nearby (or in the same dungeon). dropMul: item drop chance multiplier for party kills. dungeonOffset: a party's shared dungeon uses the average level of the party members + this (+ dungeon.perDepth per floor deeper). statMul: with minPlayers or more heroes in the world, every monster (overworld, dungeons, world bosses) gets this much more health and damage.

threat._help: The longer you play in one sitting, the harder the land pushes back. One threat level per minutesPerLevel minutes in the world (up to max); each level gives overworld monsters hpP/dmgP % more health and damage and makes them respawn respawnP % faster. Ambushes: every interval seconds (minus intervalPerLevel per level) a pack of packBase + packPerLevel x threat monsters appears ambushDist metres away and hunts you, while fewer than aliveBase + alivePerLevel x threat ambushers live. Never inside safeRadius of the village, in dungeons or the arena. Pools by realm.

tiers._help: Every 'every' floors the dungeon jumps a tier (floors 1-5 tier 0, 6-10 tier 1, ...). Each tier compounds: health x hpMul, damage x dmgMul, +levels, +extraUpgrades rolled on every monster. The tier also raises item rarity (data/loot.json dungeonDrop.bonusPerTier).
